data.one_liner: Flutter form validation and state management with typed controllers and validators.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed field controllers for text, checkboxes, dropdowns, and multi-select fields, along with built-in sync and async validation, cross-field rules, and subforms. It manages form-level state and integrates with custom validation modes.
use_when: You need complex form validation with async checks or cross-field dependencies.
You want typed field controllers without writing code generation.
You need to handle nested subforms and dynamic fields.
avoid_when: You are looking for simple built-in Flutter Form and TextFormField widgets without a custom controller architecture.
You require a code-generation-based form library.
strengths: Typed field controllers and composable validators out of the box.
Supports async validation with debouncing and timeout handling.
Granular rebuilds per field instead of rebuilding the entire form.
Handles nested subforms and conditional sections easily.
weaknesses: Requires adopting a specific controller architecture rather than standard Flutter Form fields.
Migration from standard Flutter forms requires rewriting form logic and controllers.
